recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Current core should expose Duration directly on Specimen.processing.time[x] and rely on the Extension Pack for historical/pre-R6 specimen-processingTime handling.
issue_request: FHIR-40950 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core OO R6 change request to add duration to Specimen.processing.time and remove specimen-processingTime to eliminate redundancy.
initial_application: The prior core application commit 2e47a771ff78f16314747f5451f30a1f80317784 added Duration as a type for Specimen.processing.time[x], but left the element prose describing only date/time/period and left the processingTime extension row in source/specimen/specimen-extensions-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: Specimen is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-44932 requested the same duration choice as part of the FHIR-44361 extension deprecation path and is already represented on the combined branch. The FHIR Extension Pack still carries specimen-processingTime for version-specific/pre-R6 use, including later FHIR-52827 context, so core should not keep a redundant current-R6 extension row.
reconciliation: Changed source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml to describe Specimen.processing.time[x] as time, period, or duration, and cleared the processingTime row in source/specimen/specimen-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. The OID registry and generated-looking SVG were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml: updated Specimen.processing.time[x] short and definition to explicitly include duration semantics.
source/specimen/specimen-extensions-spreadsheet.xml: cleared the processingTime extension row so core no longer defines the redundant extension.
